apps.name: tap-late
apps.subtitle: Translate Chinese as you browse
apps.localizedDescription: Read Chinese shopping apps in English with a live floating window, or translate a screenshot from Photos or Back Tap. Read a fixed area or see the whole translated page. Screenshot history and price conversion are available in the screenshot viewer.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 46 adds live Chinese-to-English translation in a floating window. Choose a fixed reading zone or the whole page. Apple Fast is the default. Apple High Fidelity is also available.
Build 33 adds dated offline price conversion, grouped local history and Apple High Fidelity retranslation.
